questions.question:
Đien tu thich hop:

The annual sales conference will _____ in Seoul next Friday.
questions.explanation: Take place = dien ra. Cau: The annual sales conference will take place in Seoul next Friday.

questions.question:

All _____ are asked to sign in before entering the seminar room.
questions.explanation: Attendees = nguoi tham du.

questions.question:
Xac đinh tu-can-đien:

The museum recently acquired a rare _____ from the 18th century.
questions.explanation: Antique = đo co.

questions.question:
Cau sau thieu mot tu. Hay chon tu phu hop:

The accounting team noticed a _____ transaction in the report.
questions.explanation: Suspicious = đang ngo. suspicious transaction = giao dich đang ngo.

questions.question:

questions.question:

questions.explanation: Expand = mo rong. expand into = mo rong sang.

questions.question:

Regular maintenance helps _____ system failures.
questions.explanation: Prevent = ngan chan. prevent failures = ngan chan su co.

questions.question:

questions.question:

questions.explanation: Qualified = đu đieu kien. qualified applicants = ung vien đu đieu kien.

questions.question:

questions.explanation: Agreement = thoa thuan. sign an agreement = ky thoa thuan.

questions.explanation: Extensive = sau rong. extensive research = nghien cuu sau rong.

questions.explanation: Guarantee = bao đam. guarantee delivery = bao đam giao hang.
